input: Research NVIDIA (nvidia.com) for a hedge fund

risks.claim: Export reopening is conditional: BIS said on 2026-01-13 that H200 and comparable-chip licenses for China would be reviewed case by case, subject to security and supply conditions. China should not be treated as an unrestricted upside market.

Demand or deployment slippage could leave substantial fixed commitments: as of 2026-07-26, NVIDIA disclosed $279 billion of supply-and-capacity commitments and $366 billion of total future commitments, including $120 billion in the remainder of FY2027.

Margin sensitivity is already visible in guidance: as issued 2026-08-26, Q3 GAAP and non-GAAP gross-margin guidance was 74.0%, versus Q2 actual margins of 75.0%. Strong revenue growth does not guarantee stable profitability.

Execution risk remains in the early-2027 DSX Pod ramp: deliveries depend on manufacturing partners, and the 2026-10-21 announcement described a reference design rather than a priced, already-shipping product.

catalysts.claim: 2026-11-17: Q3 FY2027 results and written CFO commentary expected at approximately 1:20 p.m. PT; earnings call at 2 p.m. PT. Quarter ended 2026-10-25. This is the next confirmed earnings catalyst as of 2026-11-10.

Early 2027: DSX Pod deliveries expected to begin through manufacturing partners. The reference design integrates seven Vera Rubin racks; the delivery window, reported 2026-10-21, is not an exact launch date or guaranteed revenue schedule.

event_driven.claim: As of 2026-07-26, remaining repurchase authorization was $99.3 billion. The board added $80.0 billion on 2026-05-18 without expiration; Q2 repurchases totaled $19.7 billion and first-half repurchases $39.8 billion. Authorization is discretionary, not a commitment to execute.
The quarterly dividend increased from $0.01 to $0.25 per share on 2026-05-18. Dividends paid in the quarter ended 2026-07-26 totaled $6.0 billion.

The six months ended 2026-07-26 cash-flow statement reports a $2.944 billion financing outflow labeled Groq, Inc.; accrued purchase consideration included $986 million related to the Groq non-exclusive license agreement. These are disclosed cash uses, not evidence of an acquisition of the entire company.

output.research_view: As of 2026-11-10, the immediate test is the November 17 earnings release: whether demand converts above the $108 billion Q3 revenue guide without a larger margin reset ([earnings date](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873); [guidance](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/default.aspx)). The principal underwriting tension is strong reported cash generation versus large supply commitments and conditional China access; deployment announcements should not be mistaken for booked sales ([10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000075/nvda-20260726.htm); [BIS](https://www.bis.gov/press-release/department-commerce-revises-license-review-policy-semiconductors-exported-china)).

credit_signals.claim: As of 2026-07-26, cash, cash equivalents and marketable debt securities totaled $56.586 billion; operating cash flow was $74.421 billion for the six months then ended. Liquidity figures have not been refreshed beyond that balance-sheet date.

In June 2026 NVIDIA issued $25.0 billion of senior unsecured notes across seven tranches. As of 2026-07-26, debt maturities were $1.0 billion within one year, $15.0 billion in one-to-five years, $7.5 billion in five-to-ten years and $10.0 billion beyond ten years; net carrying amount was $33.366 billion.

As of 2026-07-26, NVIDIA reported compliance with outstanding-note covenants. Its commercial-paper program had $25.0 billion capacity and no amounts outstanding. Compliance is historical, not a verification of conditions on 2026-11-10.

alternative_signals.claim: AWS and NVIDIA announced plans on 2026-08-26 for two million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS infrastructure in 2027–2028 and 100,000 GPUs on secure AWS infrastructure for government and national-security workloads. These are forward deployment plans, not recognized revenue.

NVIDIA Israel recruitment commentary reported more than 430 open positions and over 6,000 employees across five sites as of the 2026-08-02 article. This is regional hiring evidence, not a global headcount or layoff assessment.

Bloomberg reported on 2026-08-22 U.S. time that customers were notified of server-price increases exceeding 15% in many cases for early-2027 shipments, including Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell systems, amid higher memory costs. The report cites unnamed sources; these are system prices, not verified NVIDIA GPU list prices.

results_vs_guidance.claim: Latest verified reported quarter: Q2 FY2027 ended 2026-07-26. Revenue $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year; Data Center revenue $89.0 billion; GAAP EPS $2.46 and non-GAAP EPS $2.22; both gross margins 75.0%. Reported 2026-08-26.

Prior company guidance, issued 2026-05-20 for Q2 FY2027, was revenue $91.0 billion plus/minus 2%, GAAP gross margin 74.9% and non-GAAP gross margin 75.0%, each plus/minus 50 basis points. Actual Q2 revenue exceeded the guided range; actual margins were within it.
Q2 FY2027 consensus comparison as reported 2026-08-26: revenue $96.22 billion versus LSEG consensus $92.17 billion; adjusted EPS $2.22 versus $2.10 expected. Both exceeded consensus.

Current verified company guidance, issued 2026-08-26 for Q3 FY2027: revenue $108.0 billion plus/minus 2%, assuming no China Data Center compute revenue; GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins 74.0% plus/minus 50 basis points; operating expenses approximately $9.2 billion GAAP and $9.0 billion non-GAAP.
At the 2026-08-26 release, LSEG consensus for Q3 revenue was $104.2 billion, below company guidance of $108 billion. This is release-date consensus, not a verified 2026-11-10 consensus snapshot.

insider_and_ownership.claim: Director Tench Coxe reported a gift without consideration of 500,000 shares on 2026-11-04 in a Form 4 filed 2026-11-06, under a trading plan adopted 2026-03-19. This was a gift, not an open-market sale or purchase.

Vanguard Capital Management LLC reported beneficial ownership of 1,777,408,252 shares, or 7.31%, as of 2026-03-31 in its Schedule 13G filed 2026-04-28. This is historical ownership, not a current position estimate.

Third-party Q2 2026 13F aggregation, updated 2026-11-07, shows Invesco holding 329.6 million shares, up 78.4% quarter over quarter, and Morgan Stanley 356.4 million, up 3.9%. These lagged quarter-end disclosures do not establish present holdings and were not reconciled to individual fund filings.
